name: Exception Classifier Agent
fn: Classifies exception type, assigns confidence score and routes to the right analyst
detail: Classifies every unmatched item by type (short-pay, missing remittance, deduction, data mismatch), scores severity and routes it to the right analyst or downstream module with a recommended action. Cuts triage time and stops cash ageing on account.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
